description: Mean-of-items scoring for IPIP Likert instruments, as documented by IPIP: items scored 1-5, minus-keyed items reversed (6 - response), scale score is the mean of answered items, then linearly rescaled to 0-100 for display.
steps: Validate every answer is an integer within the instrument's response scale.
Reverse minus-keyed items: scored = (min + max) - response.
For each scale, if answered items < min_items_answered the scale is not scored (status 'insufficient').
raw_mean = mean of scored items for the scale (prorated over answered items).
score_0_100 = (raw_mean - min) / (max - min) * 100, rounded half-up to 1 decimal place.
negative_emotionality_0_100 = 100 - emotional_stability score_0_100 (presentation only, same information).

bands.note: Bands describe position on the response scale, NOT position relative to other people. No population norms are applied.

quality_checks.uniform_responses: Flag when 10 or more answers were given and every answer has the same value.
quality_checks.rapid_completion: Flag when server-measured completion time is under 1.5 seconds per answered item.
quality_checks.effect: Flags are shown to the user and stored for audit. They never change scores.
